name: LiveAgentExecutionAgent
description: Auto-detects how to talk to the deployed agent (HTTP endpoint or web chat UI via Playwright), sends every generated test prompt, and grades the replies with Gemini as judge.

inputs.name: live_url
inputs.description: Deployed agent URL (required in live modes)

inputs.name: test_cases
inputs.description: Generated tests, each with its DB id

inputs.name: agent_profile
inputs.description: Interface hints and purpose from RepoAnalysisAgent

outputs.name: live_reachable
outputs.description: Whether any transport reached the agent

outputs.name: live_status
outputs.description: connected | unreachable (URL down) | no_interface (site up, no chat box/API)

outputs.name: live_error
outputs.description: Why the agent could not be reached

outputs.name: execution_results
outputs.description: Per-test status, judge score, reasoning, latency and reply
